purpose: Physically validate the Computer Use P3B action-policy gate over the real capture, provider and target-resolution chain while proving that authorization creates only a low-level pointer-click plan and does not execute input.
requiredClaims: the real P1B mapped-frame path supplies the frame
the real P2B provider-neutral path normalizes observations from the local Vision PoC oracle
the real P3A resolver selects exactly one test-owned visual text target
P3B authorizes only an explicit primary-display left-click request when visual fallback consent is true
the authorized action plan uses the P3A logical target point and independently falls inside the expected fixture window
the same resolved target is rejected when explicit visual fallback consent is false
the target retains semanticIdentity null and remains intrinsically actionable false
delivery remains NOT_ATTEMPTED and semantic consequence remains NOT_OBSERVED
no pointer, click, drag, wheel or keyboard action is performed
frame payload, recognized text, target coordinates and action-plan coordinates are not persisted or logged
fixture and Computer Control runtime are cleaned up
both product working trees remain clean
nonClaims: no click is executed by P3B
authorization is not semantic task success
the visual target is not a semantic UI identity
no right-click, drag, wheel, keyboard or arbitrary visual fallback action policy is validated
no VLM or non-text target policy is validated
no arbitrary user-content OCR accuracy claim is made

promotionOnPass.nextPhase: P4 execute authorized visual fallback through Computer Control and verify an independent postcondition
